name: prospectpro
description: Fast biological R&D account whitespace, win-back, and contact intelligence from purchase history, bundled public research, and optional email context.

interface.longDescription: Turn a customer purchase-history workbook into a seller-ready biological R&D account brief through a fast evidence-to-report pipeline. ProspectPro fuzzy-matches SGNs, compares YTD purchasing, bundles current research, identifies credible whitespace and win-backs, generates maps and product links automatically, matches verified contacts, and drafts personalized unsent outreach.
defaultPrompt: Run the fast ProspectPro analysis for this customer and purchase-history workbook.
Find whitespace and lapsed-product win-backs for this account.
Set up my reusable ProspectPro writing style.
